DLG-SC-TKY-MACHIDA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-MACHIDA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの商品をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-TKY-MACHIDA-001-SHARED-01.translation: Ito po bang produkto ang gusto ninyo?

DLG-SC-TKY-MACHIDA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-MACHIDA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この共通券で払いたいです。商店街のお店なら全部使えると思っていました。
DLG-SC-TKY-MACHIDA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 共通券で支払いたいと思い込みを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-MACHIDA-001-SHARED-02.translation: Gusto ko pong magbayad gamit itong common voucher. Akala ko puwede sa lahat ng tindahan sa shopping street.
DLG-SC-TKY-MACHIDA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing nais magbayad sa voucher at ipaliwanag ang maling akala. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-MACHIDA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-MACHIDA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 参加店舗かどうか、券の案内を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-TKY-MACHIDA-001-SHARED-03.translation: Tingnan natin sa gabay ng voucher kung kasaling tindahan.

DLG-SC-TKY-MACHIDA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-MACHIDA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この店の名前を一覧で探します。商店街にあるだけで参加しているとは限らないのですね。
DLG-SC-TKY-MACHIDA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 対象店舗一覧と店名を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-MACHIDA-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hahanapin ko po ang pangalan dito sa listahan. Hindi pala awtomatikong kasali kahit nasa shopping street.
DLG-SC-TKY-MACHIDA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Itugma ang pangalan sa listahan ng sakop na tindahan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-MACHIDA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-MACHIDA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この教材では当店も対象です。ただ、券の利用条件を確認してください。
DLG-SC-TKY-MACHIDA-001-SHARED-05.translation: Sa materyal na ito, kasali ang tindahan namin. Pero tingnan ang kondisyon ng paggamit.

DLG-SC-TKY-MACHIDA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-MACHIDA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 金額以上の券を出せばおつりがあると思っていました。その扱いも聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-TKY-MACHIDA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 券額が超えた時のおつりを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-MACHIDA-001-SHARED-06.translation: Akala ko po may sukli kapag mas mataas ang voucher kaysa bayad. Gusto ko ring itanong iyon.
DLG-SC-TKY-MACHIDA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Itanong ang sukli kapag lumampas ang voucher value. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-MACHIDA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-MACHIDA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この券の案内には、おつりは出ないとあります。
DLG-SC-TKY-MACHIDA-001-SHARED-07.translation: Walang sukli ayon sa gabay nitong voucher.

DLG-SC-TKY-MACHIDA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-MACHIDA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では先に商品を増やさず、手元の現金との組合せが可能か確認します。
DLG-SC-TKY-MACHIDA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不要な商品追加前に現金併用を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-MACHIDA-001-SHARED-08.translation: Bago po magdagdag ng produkto, titiyakin ko kung maaaring isabay ang cash ko.
DLG-SC-TKY-MACHIDA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Itanong ang cash combination bago magdagdag ng hindi kailangang produkto. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-MACHIDA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-MACHIDA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この場面では併用できます。使う枚数を決めてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-MACHIDA-001-SHARED-09.translation: Sa sitwasyong ito ay puwede. Piliin kung ilang voucher.

DLG-SC-TKY-MACHIDA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-MACHIDA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一枚と現金で払います。対象店とおつり、併用条件を確認した内容でお願いします。
DLG-SC-TKY-MACHIDA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一枚と現金の支払方法を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-MACHIDA-001-SHARED-10.translation: Isang voucher at cash po. Gamitin ang natiyak na kondisyon ng tindahan, sukli at pagsasabay.
DLG-SC-TKY-MACHIDA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang isang voucher at cash bilang paraan ng bayad. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-MACHIDA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-MACHIDA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その組合せで会計します。券はこちらへお出しください。
DLG-SC-TKY-MACHIDA-001-SHARED-11.translation: Ganiyan ang ipoproseso. Ibigay rito ang voucher.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 料理の種類を伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Anong uri po ng pagkain ang order?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 三番をお願いします。辛さの表にある三番の料理です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 辛さ番号を料理品番として注文する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Numero tatlo po, iyong pagkaing nasa spice chart na tatlo.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Umorder gamit ang spice number bilang food number. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 三番は辛さの段階です。料理の種類は別に選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Spice level po ang tatlo. Hiwalay pipili ng uri ng pagkain.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 料理の品番と思っていました。まずこの野菜カレーを選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 品番の誤解を直し料理種類を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Akala ko po product number. Itong vegetable curry muna ang pipiliin.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Itama ang product-number misunderstanding at piliin ang pagkain. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 辛さの希望は、その料理について伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Tatanungin ang spice level para sa napiling pagkain.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 三番が自分に合うかは分かりません。店の説明を聞いてから段階を決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 辛さの説明を受けてから段階を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi ko po alam kung angkop ang tatlo. Pakikinggan muna ang paliwanag bago pumili ng level.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Pumili ng spice level matapos ang paliwanag. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 段階の違いを説明します。量の希望もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ipapaliwanag ang pagkakaiba. May gusto rin ba sa dami?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 量は通常でお願いします。辛さを下げることと量を減らすことは分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通常量を指定し辛さと量を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Karaniwang dami po. Ihihiwalay ko ang pagpapababa ng anghang at pagbabawas ng dami.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Piliin ang normal portion at ihiwalay ang anghang at dami. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この説明で、どの段階にしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Matapos ang paliwanag, anong level ang pipiliin?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 説明を聞いて一番にします。野菜カレー、通常量、一番の辛さでお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 料理量辛さの三条件を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Unang level po ayon sa paliwanag. Vegetable curry, normal portion at level one na anghang.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang pagkain, dami at anghang. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その三つを分けて注文を受けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Tatanggapin ang order na hiwalay ang tatlong iyon.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 料金についてのご質問ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 端末の支払いが終わるので、来月から毎月の請求も全部なくなりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 端末完済で請求全体がなくなるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Matatapos po ang bayad sa aparato; mawawala na rin ba lahat ng buwanang bill simula sa susunod na buwan?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung wala nang buong bill matapos mabayaran ang aparato. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 端末代と通信サービスの料金は別です。今の明細を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Hiwalay ang aparato at communication service. Tingnan ang kasalukuyang detalye.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 端末代が請求全体だと思っていました。この二つの欄を分けて説明してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 端末代と通信費を明細で分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Akala ko po aparato ang buong bill. Pakipaliwanag nang hiwalay ang dalawang field.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay sa bill ang aparato at service fee. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらが端末、こちらが通信です。付帯サービスも別にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ito ang aparato at ito ang serbisyo. May hiwalay ding add-on services.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 付帯サービスの名前を確認したいです。不要そうというだけで全部解約せず、何を使っているか見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 付帯サービスを調べ一括解約を避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Gusto kong tiyakin ang pangalan ng add-ons. Hindi ko basta kakanselahin lahat dahil mukhang hindi kailangan; titingnan kung ano ang gamit ko.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Suriin ang add-ons at iwasan ang sabay-sabay na cancellation. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 契約状況と変更条件は担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Titiyakin ng staff ang kontrata at change conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 変更後の金額が今の差額だけで決まるとは考えません。来月の見込みも聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 変更条件と翌月請求見込みを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Hindi ko po iisiping kasalukuyang diperensiya lang ang bagong halaga. Gusto kong itanong ang tantiya sa susunod na buwan.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Itanong ang change conditions at next-month bill estimate. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が契約と請求時期を合わせて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Sabay ipapaliwanag ang kontrata at billing period.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では今日は明細と見込みを確認し、通信まで止める手続きはまだしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 説明確認まで通信停止手続きを保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Ngayon po ay detalye at tantiya muna; hindi ko pa ipapahinto pati ang communication service.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ipagpaliban ang service stop hanggang malinaw ang paliwanag. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容で担当へご案内します。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 症状の写真をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: May larawan po ba ng sintomas?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この写真です。今日見つけたので今日の状態として見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 発見した写真を今日の状態と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Ito po. Ngayon ko nakita kaya tingnan bilang kalagayan ngayon.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipakilala ang natagpuang larawan bilang kalagayan ngayon. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 撮影した日も分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Alam din po ba ang araw ng pagkuha?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 表示を見ると三日前でした。今日フォルダーで見つけた日と混同しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 撮影日と発見日を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Tatlong araw na po ayon sa display. Napaghalo ko sa araw ngayon na nakita sa folder.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Itama ang petsa ng pagkuha at petsa ng pagkakita. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在の状態についても担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Titiyakin din ng staff ang kalagayan ngayon.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今は写真と見た目が違います。良くなったと自分で決めず、現在の状態も説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現在の見た目の違いを回復断定と分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Iba po ngayon ang hitsura sa larawan. Hindi ko sariling tatawaging gumaling; ipapaliwanag ang kasalukuyan.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang pagbabago ng hitsura at tiyak na paggaling. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 使った物があれば、その時期も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Kung may ginamit, sabihin din kung kailan.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 昨日から別のクリームを使いました。三日前の写真はその使用前です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: クリーム開始と写真の前後関係を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Ibang cream po mula kahapon. Bago iyon ginamit ang larawan ng tatlong araw na ang nakalipas.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang pagkakasunod ng cream start at larawan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 写真と使用時点を分けて担当に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Hiwalay ipapasa ang larawan at oras ng paggamit.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。写真の日付、昨日の使用開始、今の状態を順に説明し、写真だけで判断しないよう相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 三時点の経過と使用品を担当へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Pakiusap po. Sunod kong ipapaliwanag ang photo date, paggamit mula kahapon at kalagayan ngayon, at hihilinging hindi photo lamang ang batayan.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ibigay ang tatlong yugto at ginamit na produkto sa staff. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その経過を引き継ぎます。クリームの情報もお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Ipapasa ang takbong iyan. Dalhin din ang cream information.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その品は展示用の見本です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Pang-display na sample po ang produktong iyan.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ゲームの後にここから取ると思いました。まだ持ち上げていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 展示品を取ると思い未接触を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Akala ko po rito kukunin matapos ang laro. Hindi ko pa binubuhat.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing inakalang kukunin ang display ngunit hindi pa nahawakan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 獲得した物の受取方法は機械の案内で確認します。どの機械ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Sa machine guide ang pagkuha ng napanalunan. Aling makina?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。動いた箱が景品そのものか引換え用かも分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 機械を示し獲得物の役割を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Ito po. Hindi ko rin alam kung aktuwal na premyo o pangpalit ang gumalaw na kahon.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang makina at itanong ang tungkulin ng napanalunan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この教材では引換え用です。係が表示と獲得状態を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Sa materyal na ito, pangpalit. Titiyakin ng staff ang display at win status.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 画面だけで獲得できたと決めず、係に確認してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 獲得状態の確認を係に頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi ko po ipapalagay sa screen lang na nanalo; pakipatiyak sa staff.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Hilinging tiyakin ng staff ang win status. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認できました。引換え品はこちらでお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Natiyak na. Tatanggapin namin dito ang pangpalit.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 展示見本を選んで持ち帰るのでなく、引換え対象の種類を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 見本でなく引換え対象を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Sa halip na pumili at iuwi ang display, pakisabi ang uri na sakop ng palitan.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang redeemable item at hindi display. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 対象の品はこちらです。色の選択条件も説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ito ang sakop na item. Ipapaliwanag ang kondisyon ng color choice.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 条件を聞いてこの色にします。見本には触らず、係から引換え品を受け取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 色条件確認後に係から受け取る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Pipiliin ko po itong kulay matapos ang kondisyon. Hindi hahawakan ang sample at sa staff tatanggapin ang kapalit.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Pumili matapos matiyak ang kulay at tanggapin mula sa staff. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では対象の景品をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Ibibigay na ang sakop na premyo.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 画面のどの部分をお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Aling bahagi po ng screen ang tanong?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この数字が大きいので、何百人も予約で待っていると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 分類数字を予約人数と思ったと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Malaki po ang numerong ito kaya akala ko daan-daang tao ang naghihintay sa reservation.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong ang pag-aakalang reservation count ang classification number. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それは分類の情報です。予約の順番とは別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Classification information iyon, hindi reservation order.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 本を並べるための情報でしたか。自分の予約状況は別の画面で見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 分類と順番を分け予約画面を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Para po pala sa pag-aayos ng libro. Sa ibang screen ko gustong makita ang sariling reservation.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang classification at pila at humiling ng reservation screen. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 利用者の予約画面で確認できます。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この本をまだ予約していませんでした。分類画面を見ただけで順番に入ったとは言えませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未予約と確認し閲覧だけでは申込でないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi ko pa po pala nareserve. Hindi ibig sabihing nakapila na sa pagtingin lang sa classification.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihing wala pang reservation at hindi application ang pagtingin. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 予約する方法をご案内できます。版はこの本でよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ituturo ang reservation. Itong edition po ba ang gusto?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 新版を探しています。同じ題名の旧版へ申し込む前に、発行年も見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同題名の旧新版を発行年で区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Bagong edition po ang hanap. Bago mag-apply sa kapangalan na luma, pakitingnan din ang publication year.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang parehong pamagat na lumang at bagong edition gamit ang publication year. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらで版と発行年を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Tiyakin dito ang edition at year.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 新版だと確認できたので、この本の予約方法を教えてください。分類番号を待ち人数には使いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 新版確認後に予約方法を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Natiyak pong bago, kaya pakituro ang reservation nito. Hindi ko ituturing na bilang ng naghihintay ang classification.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Matapos matiyak ang bagong edition, itanong ang reservation. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、その版の予約手順をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Ituturo ang reservation ng edition na iyan.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その出来事をご自身で見たのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Kayo po ba mismo ang nakakita sa pangyayari?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人のメモを読みました。さっき見たと言いましたが、現場にいたのは友人です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 目撃者は友人で自分はメモを読んだと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Memo po ng kaibigan ang nabasa. Sinabi kong nakita kanina, pero siya ang nasa lugar.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itamang kaibigan ang saksi at sariling memo lamang ang nabasa. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: あなたが直接確認したことと、友人の話を分けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Ihiwalay ang sarili ninyong natiyak at kuwento ng kaibigan.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私は後で友人と話しました。現場の位置もメモから知ったので、自分の目撃場所として記録しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現場位置も伝聞と明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Pagkatapos po kami nag-usap. Pati lugar sa memo ko nalaman; huwag itala bilang sarili kong witness location.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Linawing mula rin sa iba ang lokasyon. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 友人ご本人へ確認できる方法はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: May paraan pong makontak mismo ang kaibigan?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 連絡はできますが、本人が説明できる時刻はまだ聞いていません。今すぐ来られるとは約束しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人の連絡可能性と来訪未確定を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Maaari po pero hindi ko pa naitanong kung kailan makapagpapaliwanag. Hindi ko maipapangakong darating agad.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang pagkontak at hindi pa tiyak na pagdating. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 連絡方法を確認します。メモの内容は、どこまでそのままですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Titiyakin ang contact method. Gaano po katapat ang memo?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 意味の分からない所を私が言い換えました。その部分は原文も見せて確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自己言い換えと原文を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Ako po ang nagsabi sa ibang paraan ng hindi ko alam na bahagi. Gusto kong ipakita rin ang orihinal sa pagtiyak.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang sariling paraphrase at orihinal. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 原文と言い換えを分けて伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Hiwalay naming pakikinggan ang orihinal at paraphrase.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。自分の観察ではないことと、言い換えた箇所を示し、本人の説明方法も相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 情報源と変更箇所を分け本人の説明方法を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Salamat po. Ipapakita ang hindi sariling obserbasyon at ang binago, at itatanong ang pagpapaliwanag niya mismo.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang source at binagong bahagi at itanong ang sariling paliwanag ng saksi. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、その区別で内容を整理しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Ayusin natin ayon sa pagkakaibang iyan.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この合計は、どの記録から作りましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Saang record po galing ang kabuuan?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 銀行の入金を全部足しました。友人から戻った立替金も入っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 全入金に立替返金を含めたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Pinagsama ko po lahat ng bank deposits. Kasama ang ibinalik ng kaibigan sa inabono ko.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing kasama sa lahat ng deposits ang reimbursement ng inabono. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 入金した事実だけで、同じ区分になるとは限りません。内容を分けて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Hindi awtomatikong parehong category dahil pumasok sa account. Ihiwalay ang detalye.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 全部を売上と書いていました。立替えと返金の記録を見せて、区分を担当に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 売上扱いを見直し資料で区分相談を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Sales po lahat ang isinulat ko. Ipapakita ang advance at reimbursement record at itatanong sa staff ang classification.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Baguhin ang sales assumption at humingi ng classification gamit ang dokumento. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 資料があれば一緒に示してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Kung may materyales, ipakita nang sabay.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 元の支払い記録と友人の返金メッセージがあります。金額が似るだけで対応すると決めず照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 元支払と返金の対応を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: May original payment record at refund message. Hindi halagang kahawig lang ang pagtutugma; ihahambing ko.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Itugma ang orihinal na bayad at reimbursement. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が内訳を確認します。集計表の扱いも案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Titiyakin ng staff ang breakdown at summary correction.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分で返金分を全部消して提出せず、元の一覧を残して確認した項目を区別します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一覧を消さず確認対象を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Hindi ko po basta buburahin lahat ng refund at isusumite; itatabi ang orihinal na listahan at ihihiwalay ang nasuri.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Huwag burahin ang listahan at ihiwalay ang tinitiyak. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その形で資料をお持ちください。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。全入金の一覧と立替資料を分け、区分と訂正方法が分かってから申告の準備を進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 内訳と訂正方法確認後に申告準備する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Opo. Hiwalay ang lahat ng deposit list at advance materials; maghahanda sa filing matapos malaman ang category at correction.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ihanda ang filing matapos malaman ang breakdown at correction. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では担当へおつなぎします。区分は資料を見て確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MACHIDA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Iuugnay sa staff. Gamit ang materyales ang pagtiyak sa category.

DLG-SC-TKY-MINATO-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-MINATO-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 撮影について何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-TKY-MINATO-001-SHARED-01.translation: May problema po ba sa pagkuha ng larawan?

DLG-SC-TKY-MINATO-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-MINATO-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 写真に明るい丸が並びます。屋外の灯りだと思いましたが、目で見る景色にはありません。
DLG-SC-TKY-MINATO-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 写真にだけ見える光を屋外の灯りか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-MINATO-001-SHARED-02.translation: May maliwanag na mga bilog sa larawan. Akala ko ilaw sa labas pero wala sa tanaw ng mata.
DLG-SC-TKY-MINATO-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung panlabas na ilaw ang liwanag sa larawan lamang. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-MINATO-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-MINATO-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 窓に室内の照明が映っている可能性があります。写真と立ち位置を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-TKY-MINATO-001-SHARED-03.translation: Maaaring repleksiyon ng ilaw sa loob sa bintana. Tiyakin ang larawan at puwesto.

DLG-SC-TKY-MINATO-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-MINATO-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 後ろの照明と同じ並びです。屋外の異常だと家族に送る前に聞いてよかったです。
DLG-SC-TKY-MINATO-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 室内灯の反射を認め誤情報送信前に確認したと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-MINATO-001-SHARED-04.translation: Pareho po ang hanay sa ilaw sa likod. Mabuting nagtanong bago ipadala sa pamilya bilang kakaiba sa labas.
DLG-SC-TKY-MINATO-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Kilalanin ang repleksiyon at sabihing natiyak bago magpadala ng mali. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-MINATO-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-MINATO-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 撮影時も通路をふさがず、窓や設備へ物を貼り付けないでください。
DLG-SC-TKY-MINATO-001-SHARED-05.translation: Huwag humarang sa daan habang kumukuha at huwag magdikit ng bagay sa bintana o kagamitan.

DLG-SC-TKY-MINATO-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-MINATO-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 反射を消すために上着を窓へ貼ることはしません。少し場所を変えて試してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-TKY-MINATO-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 窓へ物を貼らず場所変更で試したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-MINATO-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi ko po ididikit ang jacket para alisin ang reflection. Maaari bang lumipat nang kaunti at subukan?
DLG-SC-TKY-MINATO-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Huwag magdikit at hilinging magpalit ng puwesto. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-MINATO-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-MINATO-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 空いている場所で、周囲に気を付けてお試しください。立入り区画の外には出ないでください。
DLG-SC-TKY-MINATO-001-SHARED-07.translation: Subukan sa bakante nang may pag-iingat sa paligid. Huwag lumabas sa allowed zone.

DLG-SC-TKY-MINATO-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-MINATO-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 区画内で角度を変えます。同行者が写る時も、景色だけと説明して送らず確認します。
DLG-SC-TKY-MINATO-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 区画内で角度を変え同行者の写りも確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-MINATO-001-SHARED-08.translation: Sa loob po babaguhin ang anggulo. Kung kasama ang tao sa larawan, titiyakin ko rin at hindi ipadadalang tanawin lang ang paliwanag.
DLG-SC-TKY-MINATO-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Baguhin ang anggulo sa zone at tiyakin pati ang kasamang nakuhanan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-MINATO-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-MINATO-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。撮れた写真を送る前に、内容を確認してください。
DLG-SC-TKY-MINATO-001-SHARED-09.translation: Opo. Tingnan ang nilalaman bago ipadala.

DLG-SC-TKY-MINATO-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-MINATO-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 見直したら反射が減りました。今の写真にも室内の映り込みはあると分かる形で家族に送ります。
DLG-SC-TKY-MINATO-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 反射が残ると理解して写真を説明付きで共有する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-MINATO-001-SHARED-10.translation: Bumaba po ang reflection pagkatingin muli. Ipapadala sa pamilya na malinaw na may repleksiyon pa rin ng loob.
DLG-SC-TKY-MINATO-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Unawaing may natitirang reflection at ipadala nang may paliwanag. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-MINATO-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-MINATO-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのように確認してお楽しみください。設備に触れず撮影を続けられます。
DLG-SC-TKY-MINATO-001-SHARED-11.translation: Ganiyan tiyakin at masiyahan. Makapagpapatuloy nang hindi hinahawakan ang kagamitan.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 退室後の部屋ですが、残された物があれば報告してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Pagkatapos mag-check out ang kuwarto; iulat ang anumang naiwan.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 机の下に紙袋があります。空き箱と一緒にごみ袋へまとめてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 残された紙袋を廃棄に含めてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: May paper bag po sa ilalim ng mesa. Maaari bang isama sa garbage bag kasama ng empty boxes?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung maitatapon ang naiwang paper bag. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 中身や所有が不明な袋を、そのまま廃棄物にしないでください。まだ動かしていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Huwag agad itapon ang hindi alam ang laman o may-ari. Hindi pa po naililipat?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ机の下にあります。外からは布のようなものが見えますが、開けていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未移動未開封と見える状態を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Nasa ilalim pa po. May parang tela sa nakikita mula sa labas pero hindi ko binuksan.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Iulat na hindi inilipat o binuksan at ang nakikita. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 忘れ物の手順で確認します。部屋番号と見つけた場所を記録してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Lost-property procedure ang gagamitin. Itala ang room number at lugar.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 部屋番号はこの作業表です。場所は机の下の奥です。中身を衣類だと断定して書かないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 発見部屋と位置を示し中身を断定しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Nasa work sheet po ang kuwarto. Nasa pinakaloob sa ilalim ng mesa. Hindi ko itatalang damit ang laman nang tiyak.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang kuwarto at eksaktong lugar nang hindi tinitiyak ang laman. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 私が確認します。その部屋で進められる清掃は、こちらから指示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ako ang titingin. Ako rin ang magtuturo ng paglilinis na maaari roon.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 先に床を全部拭くと袋を動かしてしまうので、袋の周囲は触らず指示を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 周囲の清掃でも袋を動かさず指示を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Magagalaw po ang bag kung buong sahig agad ang pupunasan. Hindi gagalawin ang paligid at hihintayin ang tagubilin.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Huwag ilipat ang bag kahit sa paglilinis sa paligid at maghintay. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今は別の指定箇所を清掃してください。袋の情報をほかの客へ話す必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Sa ibang takdang lugar muna maglinis. Hindi kailangang sabihin sa ibang bisita ang bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。主任への報告だけにし、廃棄へ混ぜず、指定された箇所の清掃を進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 報告先を主任に限定し別の指定箇所を進める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Sige po. Sa supervisor lamang iuulat, hindi ihahalo sa basura at itutuloy ang itinakdang ibang lugar.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Limitahan sa supervisor ang report at ituloy ang ibang lugar. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、記録を受け取って確認します。袋を扱う前には私を呼んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MINATO-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Tatanggapin ko ang tala at susuriin. Tawagin ako bago hawakan ang bag.
